page_title: OSA 1-1 MAL | Osasuna v Mallorca 14/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
88' Bittor Alkiza has decided to substitute Raul Garcia and he is replaced by Max Svensson (Osasuna).
85' Rough tackle by Jesus Areso (Osasuna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle as Raul Garcia (Osasuna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaume Costa (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch for Toni Lato.
83' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
80' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes.
77' The attendance for today's match is 17852.
76' Substitution. Nacho Vidal walks off the pitch and Jose Copete (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
76' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Samu Costa (Mallorca) replaces Manu Morlanes.
75' Here is a change. Ruben Garcia is going off and Bittor Alkiza gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
75' Substitution. Ruben Pena will be replaced by Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
74' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
72' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post.
71' Toni Lato (Mallorca) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Aitor Fernandez reacts superbly to deny him.
66' Here comes a substitution. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Aimar Oroz.
66' Bittor Alkiza decides to make a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz will be replaced by Johan Mojica (Osasuna).

65' 1 - 1 Goal! Sergi Darder (Mallorca) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Aitor Fernandez is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
65' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
58' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Francisco Maeso signals a foul.
56' The goalkeeper dives to deny Iker Munoz (Osasuna), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
50' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' The game is over for Omar Mascarell (Mallorca). Abdon Prats comes on for the second half.
46' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
40' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aitor Fernandez intercepts the ball.
39' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
32' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
27' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
27' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes a slide tackle, but referee Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
23' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' One of the Osasuna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
19' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' 1 - 0 Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
13' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
11' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Francisco Maeso signals a set piece.
8' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.
6' A cross into the box from Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is cleared.
3' A pass by Ruben Pena (Osasuna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
